# mg37-desktopgl-installdir

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

An old MonoGame 3.7 DesktopGL project from the installer era: `HintPath` entries in the install folder, separate `OpenTK` and `NVorbis` references, and a `Content.mgcb` that references the install folder, a custom pipeline assembly and a custom importer. It is never built.

## Positive for

MG001, MG002, MG003, MG004, MG005, MG006, MG017, MG019, MG023, MG025, MG026.
